description:
Design, verify, and predeclare the coverage-repairing amendment to the layout-attribution ensemble's axes, per amendment section 6.6's coverage branch and owner decision DEC-G (2026-08-21, delegation arm).

## Background

The third post-cutover session (`dev/benchmarks/tuning_profiles/2026-08-20-post-cutover-receipt-3.md`) reports the attribution audit RESULT: FAIL on the coverage precondition: at `bit_backend/or_inplace/words=1` the ensemble's reference-arm dispersion s_R = 0.047448 falls below the sigma-hat/2 floor of 0.059077 (80.3 %), and at `bit_backend/xor_inplace/words=1` s_R = 0.038850 falls below 0.049556 (78.4 %). Per `layout-attribution-verdict-v1.md` section 6.6, the three alignment axes are not a model of natural-rebuild layout variation at those cells, no larger K repairs that, and the axes are the subject of a tracked amendment before the next measured run.

The owner delegated the design and approves the final amendment text before any measured run. Section 6.6 already rejected `-C link-arg=-Wl,--sort-section=name` for moving no symbol; the axis this task finds must demonstrably move code placement in a way that reaches the coverage floor at both failing cells.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed verification receipt demonstrates, by building and measuring an ensemble (or a predeclared subset sufficient to estimate s_R at the two failing cells), that the amended axis set reaches the sigma-hat/2 coverage floor at `bit_backend/or_inplace/words=1` and `bit_backend/xor_inplace/words=1`, while preserving the parity/balance construction of sections 3.1-3.2 and leaving the precision, half-split-null, and decorrelation machinery computable unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: An additive amendment document (v2, referencing v1 and changing none of its text) predeclares the amended enumeration, its member formula, K, and the unchanged verdict rules before any measured run; no predeclared value moves — not tau_cell, tau_set, the pinned set, the schema token, or the three-standard-error margin.
- [hard] REQ-03: The amendment text is presented to the epic's owner and carries the owner's recorded approval before the next measured session is dispatched.

## Constraints

- Benchmark-mode work: uncontended host per repository benchmark policy; verify the host is idle first.
- Standing receipts and the v1 amendment are not modified.
- No `.jit/` writes; no issue state transitions; link durable artifacts with `jit doc add`.
title: Predeclare the coverage-repairing ensemble-axes amendment v2
